title: originalità. confezione
review: Il coriere è arrivato super veloce, maQuesto prodotto è stato ricevuto senza la pellicola di protezione. Il tappo si apre molto facilmente, il che solleva dubbi sull'integrità della confezione. Di conseguenza, non è possibile verificare quale prodotto sia effettivamente contenuto all'interno, poiché il contenuto potrebbe essere stato sostituito o manomesso prima della consegna.Ritengo che il prodotto possa non essere originale (contraffatto) oppure non corrispondere alle caratteristiche dichiarate. Per un marchio di questo livello, una situazione del genere non è accettabile. Non lo consiglio.

title: Arrivato già aperto
review: Onestamente sono perplessa: è evidentemente arrivato aperto. Nessuna confezione intorno, né plastica, né carta.Buttato lí, nel pacco. Nessun anello ferma erogatore. Macchiato. Non faccio il reso perché già distruggo l'ambiente comprando on line, rimandare indietro un detergente viso, facendo macinare altri chilometri, mi pare troppo. Però sui prodotti corpo è abbastanza disgustoso questa politica del riciclare prodotti usati. Lo userò per i piedi, non so.

Wer von Natur aus eine sehr empfindliche und sehr trockene Haut hat - erst einmal Pröbchen aus der Apotheke anfragen.Ich habe mir also fröhlich das Gesicht mit der Reinigungsmilch gewaschen und danach die Cremes aufgetragen. Mit dem Erfolg, dass ich ein paar Stunden später ausgesehen habe, wie eine aufgequollene Tomate. Meine Haut hat also hoch allergisch auf die Produkte von Roche reagiert.Schade. title: Detergente delicato perfetto per pelli sensibili
review: Uso questo prodotto come detergente da qualche settimana e mi sta piacendo moltissimo. In famiglia siamo in due ad avere la pelle sensibile e reattiva, e trovare un detergente che vada bene ad entrambi e che  idrati senza irritare non è facile, ma questo prodotto è davvero delicato.La consistenza è leggera e piacevole da massaggiare sul viso. Rimuove bene le impurità senza lasciare la pelle che tira. Dopo l’uso la pelle risulta pulita, morbida e lenita, con meno rossori rispetto ad altri detergenti che ho provato.Apprezzo molto il fatto che lasci la pelle idratata e la mancanza di profumazioni forti che in generale proprio non cerco.Il formato da 400 ml dura parecchio, quindi anche il rapporto qualità-prezzo è ottimo.Lo consiglio soprattutto a chi ha pelle sensibile, facilmente irritabile o soggetta a rossori.

title: Greasy, VERY greasy.
date: Reviewed in the Netherlands on 17 June 2023
review: Nice product if you want to clean your eyes. It's also a nice lubricant for "other things" (yes, I mean it, you likely know).I would NOT use it to clean my face, though, it's very greasy. I also have to wash my hands thoroughly after using it to get rid of all that "oil".It's nice that it allows me to really wash my eyes without stinging, though, including the water line. Might be good to remove makeup too. I'd not consider it cleaning my face by itself, though, maybe even the opposite if you have oily skin. I assume that if you use it to remove makeup you need to wash your face with something to remove all that oil after. Might be an ok alternative when your skin is VERY dry because of winter or any other condition, perhaps then it would be okay, but I dare to say it does not feel like I am cleaning my skin when using it.You can use its lubricant capabilities for entertainment purposes as well. 😁

title: Kommt nicht gegen Schminke an
review: Die Reinigungsmilch kommt mit einer wirklich angenehmen Konsistenz daher, und der Spender macht die Entnahme so unkompliziert, dass selbst morgendliche Schlafmützen damit klarkommen. Die Reinigung fühlt sich sehr angenehm an, und die Milch hinterlässt einen zarten, pflegenden Film auf der Haut. Auch der Duft hält sich angenehm im Hintergrund.Für Menschen, die ungeschminkt durchs Leben gehen, ist diese Reinigungscreme vermutlich ein Volltreffer. Und genau hier liegt leider mein Problem und der Grund für die drei Sterne.Ich gehöre nämlich nicht zur Fraktion „voll geschminkt“, sondern eher zur Kategorie „ein bisschen Farbe schadet nicht“: ein Hauch getönte Foundation und etwas wasserlösliche Wimperntusche. Eigentlich nichts, was eine Reinigungsmilch ins Schwitzen bringen sollte.Doch trotz warmem Wasser, reichlich Produkt und engagiertem Rubbeleinsatz hielt meine Wimperntusche tapfer die Stellung.  Nach dem Abtrocknen zeigte mir mein Handtuch schließlich unmissverständlich: Die Schminke war immer noch da.Mein Fazit: Wer sich nicht schminkt, bekommt hier eine wunderbar sanfte und pflegende Reinigungscreme. Wer jedoch auch nur ein bisschen Make-up trägt, sollte sich auf Verstärkung verlassen oder gleich zu einem anderen Produkt greifen. Für die Hautpflege top,  für die Make-up-Entfernung leider eher Zuschauer als Spieler.

review: It is gently and good product but I feel my face is not clean as it should be after using it. It is good as make up remover but as a cleaner ehm I feel I need to use another product after it.

title: Weird sticker
review: Received, but came with this sticker over the whole bottle that is awful to take off, can’t read anything on the bottle. Product inside overall is good. Love Roche-Posay products.

title: Nicht zum Entfernen von Make-Up geeignet
review: Hinterlässt ein angenehmes Gefühl auf der Haut, Make-Up entfernt es allerdings leider nicht gründlich.

title: Schminkt Wimperntusche leider gar nicht ab
review: Das Produkt ist sicher ganz wunderbar für die Haut und ich mag es auch, dass ich nach dem Reinigen eine Haut wie eingecremt habe.ABER es entfernt mein Make-up leider gar nicht.Meine Augen sehen aus wie ein Panda, da die Wimperntusche gar nicht abgeht und das kenne ich so nicht. Ich muss daher immer vor- oder nacharbeiten mit einem anderen Produkt, welchen abschminkt.Daher würde ich das Produkt nicht nochmals bestellen und es verspricht nicht das, was ich mir vorstelle - schade bei den hohen Preis.

title: Feels more like a moisturiser
review: feels more like a moisturiser than a cleanser. The texture is very creamy not really for me as a cleanser should be it does hydrate the skin but that’s it doesn’t really clear the pores

title: Good for Sensitive skin but not the best
review: I was Expecting more from Laroche-Posay, especially at this price point.I have a very sensitive skin so I decided to give this product a try. My skin tolerated it but it left a greasy feel even after rinsing thoroughly. Does not dehydrate the skin which is good but It felt like its cleansing ability was a little to mild.

title: Falta envoltorio en la caja
review: Acabo de empezarlo y no puedo opinar mucho, solo que sí hidrata bien la piel. No le doy más estrellas porque para más seguridad creo que el producto debería venir precintado por fuera. Simplemente viene en su caja y tampoco está precintada. Por lo demás ok.

title: It's giving nothing.
review: This stuff isn't bad.. but it also isn't good. As in, it didn't break my skin out and threaten to steal my firstborn child.. but it also didn't improve my skin or skincare routine whatsoever.I had previously been using The Ordinary's squalene cleanser but wanted to try this product for "fun". Was just feeling random and whacky idk. I would never use this stuff to take makeup off- why? it's so expensive ? just use ponds cold cream or micellar water?I think if your skin is incredibly sensitive - like your skin is easily traumatized by products and you experience a lot of allergic or inflammatory reactions to certain ingredients- then maybe this stuff will be your saviour.

title: La salud.
review: Producto bueno, embalaje, pésimo.

title: It’s alright ….
review: I like the face wash .. but it’s defiantly not one you use to take your makeup off with. I would suggest using this once all make up is removed , it doesn’t take it off and leave an oily layer .

title: Leaves film on my face
review: Leaves some strange film feeling on the skin, i dont think its washing anything off. I had some pimple spot treatment - cleanser didnt smudge it even...i know its for the sensitive skin, but personally its doing too little

title: Greasy feeling, but not too dry on skin
review: It feels like you're washing your face with some creamy oil, and it does leave somewhat of a greasy residue on your skin (not the dirty type of grease though, its a different kind of grease that feels clean). It takes some getting used to, but it's not overly drying and that's what my skin needed! I think my skin definitely feels less dry/tight when I come out of the shower now after using this product. I would say if you can't get used to the feeling of not having squeaky clean skin, don't buy this product but if you have super dry skin from your current cleanser, definitely try this one out!! Also no scent whatsoever (no weird smells)

title: Sensitivity
review: Bought this product because I have sensitive skin.  Apparently, I have ultra sensitive skin as my face still went red and burning.  Don’t go by my rating, sure it will work for others.

title: Some minor issues
date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 5 February 2020
review: I have very sensitive skin so I thought I'd give this product a try as it was said to be suitable for intolerant skin. I get mild rosacea after washing my face with this but it's tolerable and fades quickly. I get it much worse with other products. I wouldn't say it's the best cleanser I've ever used. I used it without rinsing which is the type of cleanser I was looking for and this cleanser is supposedly fine as a no rinse cleanser. I found when I did it this way my skin flared up and was quite red so unfortunately I have to rinse it off which is not ideal for dry sensitive skin. Probably won't buy again as it's just a bit expensive for me however you get a fair amount that will last, it's just not ideal for my skin.

title: Have they changed the formula?
review: I loved this face wash, but my most recent bottle purchased on Amazon has a bad smell unlike previous bottles.

title: The product was ok but my i got the defective product and the nozel was broken
review: The nozelWas broken.

title: Waxy feel
date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 6 August 2017
review: My first time trying this product. First thing I've realised about it is that my face feels like it has a coat of wax over it after washing it off, which I've never experienced with other cleansers before. I'm not too sure if that's the way it's supposed to be, which is why it might be good with people with sensitive skin, being more oil based. I've since used it for 2 weeks or so, no breakouts, but my skin has always been okay (combination). Anyway, I've decided that I'm going to stop using it even though it hasn't affected me because I just can't tell if my skin is getting cleaned properly due to the waxy feeling.

title: Good product
review: I'm not a fan of cream makeup removal cleansers. I find I use a lot of product to remove my make up. I use very minimal make up. Foundation, eyeliner and mascara. So this cream was no different. But by the time I did remove all my make up it did leave my skin feeling moisturized.

title: It's OK but I won't purchase again.
review: It does what it's supposed to do and cleans my face however I'm not happy with how it rinses or how my face feels once it's rinsed. It doesn't feel clean, if that makes sense. It just doesn't make my face feel as clean as I would like.

title: No es lo que esperaba.
review: Decidí pasar a una cosmética de "mejor calidad" ya que tengo la piel sensible y con rosácea. Después de buscar otros limpiadores me decidí por este por una oferta puntual. La verdad es k me siento decepcionada, no he encontrado ninguna diferencia al respecto de otros. Pensaba que con este limpiador se atenuarian las rojeces y no ha sido así. No estoy descontenta con su compra pero creo que no es diferente de otros más baratos. No recomendaría su compra.

title: Okay -- would not buy it again.
review: Not as gentle as I thought it would be -- I prefer Cetaphil over this.
